idea-plugin.name: Onboarder
idea-plugin.description:
Onboarder renders an interactive architecture map of the open project — endpoints → controllers → services → repositories → database tables — plus AI summaries, an investigation chat, and Jira/ADO ticket → fix suggestions.

Analysis runs locally, in place: the plugin ships a self-contained engine and starts it as a background process. No zip upload, no Python, no server to run.

Connected to your IDE's AI. Onboarder also runs as an MCP server, so JetBrains AI Assistant (and any MCP-capable assistant) can query the code graph, trace a flow, and read the exact source behind a node — grounding its answers in the real architecture. A one-click action also hands Onboarder's evidence-backed context to the AI tool window.
